evidence: All five prompts (task/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1) open with 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright.' and continue 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' This matches the skill's Verify (quality-checks.md:109: every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool) and the contract (staged-task-contract.md:156: no prompt may derive a verdict from the submission's source). Every judge.toml declares [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright', command='playwright-mcp' (lines 8-12); functional additionally declares only the restart 'verifier' server, and its prompt (line 1, D at line 51) restricts it to one restart_app call with 'No shell'. test.sh:196-201 substitutes app_context (URL http://localhost:3000, accounts, intent-level screens with 'never assume the reference implementation's routes, selectors or field names') into every tests/*/*/prompt.md, so no dimension is left without the URL. Not satisfiable from source/memory/first paint: (a) render gate (render/judge.toml:23) requires an invalid-password refusal plus a valid sign-in into a usable workspace — not a first paint; (b) constraints gate and the in-dimension gate restated in functional:11-13, polish:9-12, visual:9-12 require a UI-created job and candidate read back by the Observer in a fresh browser context ('A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check'); (c) functional protocols Z..D are multi-session, replay-based and restart-based browser interactions; (d) polish criteria use document.activeElement, getBoundingClientRect, route abort/setOffline and second tabs; (e) visual (likert) is explicitly a post-gate read-only tour of Board, card details, Noor's conversation, Activity and the candidate view, and a failed gate gives raw 1 (visual/prompt.md:12-14), so a pretty first-paint mock cannot score. The seeded facts the functional Z protocol names (Platform Engineer order, Noor's note) are read in the app, not graded from memory. Tool feasibility: the prompts' independent-context recipe names browser_run_code_unsafe and allows 'A supported separate-context tool' as an alternative; separate-task evidence (MCP_RECIPE_COMPATIBILITY.json) shows browser_run_code_unsafe dispatching on the same pinned @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile:19). Compared with the frozen template prompts ('Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), the task prompts keep the browser directive and tighten the source prohibition. Adversarial tries: a static shell or seeded-JSON mock that paints a convincing board is zeroed by every dimension's gate (cross-context readback of new records); a conforming app with different routes, labels or a non-drag move UI is accommodated ('Discover routes and controls by intent', 'no dragging required', 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording', functional:15). Residual scope note (not a defect of this row): judge.toml isolated=false means the claude-code judge may have file tools; the prompts forbid their use, which is all this row can require. Whether the configured judge actually follows these directives is unmeasured — raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'; that runtime gap belongs to the runtime/workload rows and is not waived by this verdict.
